newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-ZAMALEK FAVOURITES FOR AFRICAN SUPER CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZAMALEK FAVOURITES FOR AFRICAN SUPER CUP.

text.p: Egyptian club Zamalek are overwhelming favourites to lift the African Super Cup when they meet compatriots Arab Contractors in Cairo on Friday.
It will be the second time that two Egyptian teams have met in the final in the five-year history of the Super Cup.
On the first occasion in 1994, Zamalek beat arch-rivals Al Ahli 1-0 in Johannesburg and should they win again on Friday will become the first club to win the trophy twice.
They qualified for this year's Super Cup by beating Shooting Stars of Nigeria on penalties in the African Champions' Cup final in December.
They lead the Egyptian first division by eight points but, along with Arab Contractors, were beaten in league action last weekend.
Arab Contractors, who are also based in Cairo but live in the shadow of Al Ahli and Zamalek, won the African Cup Winners' Cup last year with a convincing 4-0 aggregate win over Sodigraf of Zaire.
Previous winners of the Super Cup include Wydad Casablanca of Morocco, Esperance of Tunisia and South Africa's Orlando Pirates, who beat JS Kabylie of Algeria 1-0 in last year's final.
